high_level_description: addCriterion The image is a screenshot of a news article from "Business Today." The headline reads: "'Elon Musk’s dream hijacked': China’s maglev train hits speeds he could only imagine." The article was published 3 hours ago, as indicated at the bottom left corner of the image. The main focus of the image is a photograph of a high-speed maglev (magnetic levitation) train. The train is sleek and futuristic, with a predominantly silver body and a blue stripe running along its side.
